main_text.p: inter Calixtinos & Pontificios, art. v. hoc tamen, Laicis non prohibetur, ut in aedibus privatis Biblia legantur familiis sine omni additione, seu expositione. Vrgendum, quovis pacto est, ut id vulgo contingat, atque ab omnibus gnaviter frequentetur studium, ad salutem aeque necessarium & utile. Quod, uti argumentum causae nostrae bonae est, dum intrepide non modo concedimus cuivis Sacrae Scripturae lectionem, sed injungimus etiam, & ardentissime expetimus, adeo ut nihil nobis inde metuamus, quemadmodum qui tenebras cupiunt & amplexantur; ita & medium optimum est, quo divina veritas ad animas certius penetret, & ad quoscunque diffundatur. Atque haec res eo diligentius commendari debet, quo in Papatu multi sunt qui quod ipsis prohibetur Scriptura, aegre ferunt, & lectionem ejus usumque urgent. Inter ipsos Hispanos scripsit Fernandus Texeda, conversus Monachus, plures Scriptores extare, qui idem clamant, atque ex illorum adductis testimoniis peculiari libello id ostendit, Londini impresso, anno MDCXXIV. Exhortation of a Spanish converted Monke: collected out of the Spanish Authours them selves, to reade & peruse the holy Scriptures. Qui primus Biblia Belgice edidit a. MCCCCLXXVII. impressa Delphis Hollandorum, apud Jacobum Jacobi, & Mauritium Imants Mediobargensem, in Praefatione, hunc in modum facius suum excusare & defendere necesse habuit: Nochtans wete ick dat het sal werden ter bernt onder die clergie/ hoewel dat sy nochtans weten sullen die ooghaerlijckheyt daer af. Want sommige Clercken tozent, dat datmen de heymelijckheyt der Schriftuere den gemeynen volcke soude ontbinden / ende dat besondere die de minste Clercken sijn / ende en willen niet weten dat Christus Apostelen in alle tongen spraken / ende haer leeringe ende predicatie den volcke

page.notes: Much of the lower half is in black letter (Dutch) and heavily blurred; the Dutch words are transcribed with uncertainty and several are marked as doubtful. The Roman numerals in the date are read from the reversed-C forms. The catchword at bottom right is doubtful. The first Latin word of the Latin section and the Dutch line breaks may not match the printed line endings exactly.
